purpose: Defines the rules for passing per-process transient data (requests and results) between a calling SKILL and a custom Agent using identifiers, script-written files, and exit values.

summary: Scope: only data that exists during a single process, not permanent documents
Rationale: passing full content via prompt or return value breaks at scale, adds AI relay corruption, and leaves format undefined
Only identifiers are carried to the agent; scripts generate them and decide storage locations
Scripts write data; the AI passes values by arguments or JSON via stdin using a quoted heredoc
Readers get an absolute path from a script and read the file directly; JSON bodies are never printed to stdout
Values must arrive unchanged, including newlines, quotes, backticks, and non-ASCII characters
Field meaning lives in the SKILL.md or agent definition of the reading and writing party, not carried with values
Finalize decisions before writing, with no overwrite operation
Exit value is a string, "0" for success; failure is detected by absence, with a closed set of error values
Format validation is avoided except for AI-supplied JSON via stdin; data is deleted after processing
